identity.fantasy: A mobile Ignite specialist who layers long burns and detonates their stored value with Explode or Pyroclasm.
identity.one_line: Apply Ignite and Infernus, build Heat and periodic coverage, then use Fired Up before consuming stored damage at the profitable moment.

mechanics.core_loop: Maintain burns, use instant Ember spenders under Fired Up, and detonate only after enough periodic value accumulates.

modes.name: Pyroclasm
modes.structural_description: Consumes 1 EmberCreate a pyroclasm instantly consuming your Burning effects on a target to deal the two times total periodic damage plus an additional 2100 to 2220 over 10 seconds, piercing absorption effects and resistances.

mechanics.single_target: Durable targets reward full DoT coverage and delayed Pyroclasm.
mechanics.aoe: Spread burns and use resets, though players describe AoE as weaker than Draconic.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ignite and instant spenders permit kiting; detonation setup constrains swaps.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Control and mobile damage support kiting more than durability.
mechanics.group_utility: Sustained burns and dispel punishment create pressure.

failure_modes.text: Early Pyroclasm consumption sharply reduces payoff.
Fired Up without Embers wastes burst.
